title: Upgrade worker and worker-build to 0.9 and pin worker-build in the build command
description:
## Problem

The Cloudflare build command in `wrangler.toml` installs worker-build without a version:

    cargo install -q worker-build && worker-build --release

Since worker-build 0.9.0 was published, that command builds nothing for this project:

- **worker-build 0.9.0** (latest on crates.io, checked 2026-11-24) refuses the `worker` crate the project uses:
  `Unsupported version worker@0.8.3, expected at least worker@0.9.0`.
- **worker-build 0.8.7** (the global install on this VPS) fails at the wasm-bindgen step: the wasm-bindgen CLI rejects the
  `--force-enable-abort-handler` flag it passes. Cargo.lock has wasm-bindgen 0.2.122.
- **worker-build 0.8.3** is the only version that currently builds this project. It was used for the local `wrangler dev`
  test of `resolve_goto_urls` on 2026-11-24.

Effect: the next push to `main` starts a Cloudflare build that will almost certainly fail, so production stays on the old code.
The `resolve_goto_urls` commits 74918f1, f31d0b1 and b682cb7 are waiting on this. `wrangler.toml` now has `name = "rusty-serp"`,
so a successful build deploys straight to production.

## Work

1. Read the workers-rs changelog for worker 0.9.0 and list breaking changes that touch this code: `Request`, `Response`,
   `Headers`, `RequestInit`, `Fetch`, `Env::secret`, `Url`, and the `#[event(fetch)]` entry point.
2. In `Cargo.toml`, change `worker = "0.8"` to `"0.9"`. Run `cargo update -p worker`, then fix any compile errors.
3. Pin the build tool in the `wrangler.toml` build command, so the next worker-build release can't break builds again:
   `cargo install -q worker-build --version <0.9.x> --locked`.
4. Update the PRD to match: the build command at §~565 and `worker = "0.8"` at §~592.
5. Build with the pinned worker-build, run `wrangler dev`, and smoke-test it:
   - `/health` returns 200
   - a wrong csvkey returns 401
   - depth 201 returns 400 `invalid_depth`
   - one live call per endpoint (standard and `.ai`) returns status 20000 with no `google.com/goto` links

   Run wrangler under nvm Node, not the Bun-run wrangler on PATH, which can't forward requests in dev.

Fallback if the 0.9 upgrade stalls and a deploy is needed first: pin `--version 0.8.3 --locked` in the build command.
This is a stopgap, not the fix.

## Acceptance

- `worker` 0.9.x is in Cargo.lock, and the build command pins worker-build with `--version` and `--locked`.
- These all pass: `cargo check --all-targets`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`,
  `cargo test`, and `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`. `ubs` has been run on the changed files.
- `worker-build --release` succeeds with the pinned version, and the `wrangler dev` smoke tests above pass.
- The Cloudflare build for the pushed commit succeeds, and production `/health` answers.

comments.author: claude-opus
comments.text:
Local verification, 2026-11-24 (before push):

- Cargo.toml worker 0.8 -> 0.9; Cargo.lock worker/worker-macros/worker-sys 0.9.0, wasm-bindgen 0.2.130. No source changes needed.
- The 0.8.4-0.9.0 release notes list no breaking change to the APIs used here (Request, Response, Headers, RequestInit, Fetch, Env::secret).
- cargo check --all-targets, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, cargo test (2 passed): all pass.
  cargo +stable check and clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown: pass.
- From an empty root, `cargo install worker-build --version 0.9.0 --locked` installs 0.9.0.
- `worker-build --release` (0.9.0, stable): 374 KB wasm.
  It warns that `target_features` is missing because of strip = true. That is harmless: wasm-bindgen 0.2.130 then infers
  reference types from the externref exports (cli-support/src/lib.rs, around line 425).
- `wrangler dev` (4.167.0, compat date 2026-05-03): the worker loads with worker 0.9's tracing hooks.
  - health GET and HEAD return 200
  - a missing csvkey returns 400; a wrong csvkey returns 401
  - invalid JSON returns 400; depth 201 returns 400 invalid_depth
  - GET /v1/serp returns 405
  - live standard call: 200 in 110.0 s, task status 20000, data.resolve_goto_urls=true, 0 google.com/goto links, cost $0.002
  - live .ai call: 200 in 85.7 s, status 20000, 0 google.com/goto links
  - no panics or exceptions in the dev log
- Wrangler 4.96.0 (the copy in the nvm v22.22.3 globals) failed to start because of local .wrangler state written by a newer
  workerd. That is unrelated to the build; it ran fine on 4.167.0.

Remaining before close: the Cloudflare build for the pushed commit succeeds, and production /v1/health answers.
